traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Aquifoliales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Aquifoliales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral.

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Aquifoliales page (read 2026-10-16): toothed simple leaves throughout (division not stated; all families state simple).

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Aquifoliales page (read 2026-10-16): shrubs or trees, all woody.

traits.leaf_habit.note: APweb, Aquifoliales page (read 2026-10-16): no order statement; Helwingiaceae deciduous or evergreen; Ilex mostly evergreen (stated by family). Weighting ours.

traits.inflorescence.note: APweb, Aquifoliales page (read 2026-10-16): Aquifoliaceae cymose, often subumbellate; Phyllonomaceae monochasial cymes. eflora Citronella panicles.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Aquifoliales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): inflorescence axillary. Helwingia and Phyllonoma carry them on the leaf blade (see conflicts).

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb, Aquifoliales page (read 2026-10-16): small regular flowers in all families (symmetry not stated; all families state actinomorphic).

traits.corolla_shape.note: APweb, Aquifoliales page (read 2026-10-16): Aquifoliaceae petals imbricate, joined only at the base, spreading; our reading as rotate.

traits.hypanthium.note: APweb, Aquifoliales page (read 2026-10-16): no hypanthium described; all families with candidates state false.

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb, Aquifoliales page (read 2026-10-16): Helwingiaceae and Phyllonomaceae have inferior ovaries; Ilex superior (family value).

traits.fruit_type.note: APweb, Aquifoliales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): fruit with separate pyrenes (stones).

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Aquifoliales page (read 2026-10-16): many Ilex dioecious, Helwingia usually dioecious, Phyllonoma perfect. eflora: Citronella moorei dioecious.
